name: nodex
description: P2P distributed dynamic cache network with browser nodes as encrypted Service Worker peers

scripts.beta:local: concurrently --names api,app "npm run beta:server" "npm run beta:next:dev"
scripts.beta:next:dev: npm run beta:runtime && next dev apps/beta-suite --port 4174
scripts.beta:next:build: tsx scripts/clean-runtime-dist.ts && npm run build && tsx scripts/sync-beta-runtime.ts && next build apps/beta-suite
scripts.beta:stack: concurrently --prefix "[{name}]" --names "api,signal,beta,preview" "npm run server" "npm run signaling" "npm run beta:server" "npx vite preview --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4173 --strictPort"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p src/sw/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p apps/beta-suite/tsconfig.json
scripts.validate:external: playwright test tests/phase-07.spec.ts --project=chromium && npm run metrics:export
scripts.demo: playwright test tests/phase-05.spec.ts tests/phase-06.spec.ts --project=chromium && npm run metrics:export
